items.title: Leaking Circuit Secrets: Gradient Leakage Attacks on Graph Neural Networks
items.summary: As graph neural networks (GNNs) become standard tools for critical tasks in circuit design and analysis, their security and privacy risks require careful attention. Here, we present the first comprehensive evaluation of gradient leakage attacks (GLAs) on GNNs in circuit-design and hardware-security tasks, a practical threat that has been largely overlooked. We assess state-of-the-art (SOTA) GNNs, including GraphSAGE, GCN, GIN, and GAT, trained on standard netlist benchmarks (ISCAS'85, EPFL, and TrustHub), for their fundamental vulnerability to GLAs. We find that GLAs can expose sensitive information, such as gate types and distinctive properties of hardware Trojans, which may assist adversaries in analyzing logic locking schemes or evading Trojan detection mechanisms. Our analysis shows that these risks are influenced by architectural features, with attention mechanisms (GAT) exacerbating leakage, while injective aggregation (GIN) provides comparatively stronger resilience. We further evaluate several SOTA defense techniques, including differential privacy, gradient clipping, secure aggregation, model compression with quantization, and adversarial training. We find that these techniques improve resilience only in specific settings and can also compromise model performance. Overall, our work provides key insights toward privacy-preserving GNNs and highlights the need for more robust and efficient defenses. We release our full methodology and artifacts.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次系统评估了图神经网络（GNN）在电路设计与硬件安全任务中面临梯度泄漏攻击（GLA）的脆弱性。随着GNN在电路分析与设计中广泛应用，其安全与隐私风险日益凸显。研究选取了四种主流GNN架构（GraphSAGE、GCN、GIN、GAT），在标准网表基准（ISCAS'85、EPFL、TrustHub）上训练，并实施梯度泄漏攻击。实验表明，攻击者可通过梯度信息恢复敏感数据，如门类型和硬件木马的独特特征，这有助于对手分析逻辑锁定方案或绕过木马检测。分析发现，注意力机制（GAT）会加剧泄漏，而注入式聚合（GIN）则表现出更强的鲁棒性。研究还评估了多种防御技术（差分隐私、梯度裁剪、安全聚合、量化压缩、对抗训练），结果表明这些方法仅在特定设置下有效，且可能影响模型性能。本文为隐私保护型GNN提供了关键见解，并呼吁开发更高效、鲁棒的防御手段。完整方法论与工具已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示GNN在电路设计任务中易受梯度泄漏攻击，威胁硬件知识产权与木马检测机制，为硬件安全领域引入新的攻击面。

items.why_it_matters: 首次揭示GNN在电路设计任务中易受梯度泄漏攻击，威胁硬件知识产权与木马检测机制，为硬件安全领域引入新的攻击面。

items.title: CrypFormBench: Benchmarking Formal Analysis Capability of Large Language Models for Cryptographic Schemes
items.summary: Manual formal analysis of cryptographic schemes is labor-intensive and requires substantial expertise. While model-checking tools (e.g., Scyther and Tamarin) and computational-security tools (e.g., CryptoVerif and EasyCrypt) improve the automation of security proofs, they still rely on experts to abstract schemes and write tool-specific formal descriptions. Large language models (LLMs) are a promising alternative, but their effectiveness in this domain remains unexplored due to the absence of standardized evaluation methodologies. To fill this gap, we introduce CrypFormBench (C.F.B for short), a comprehensive benchmark jointly covering symbolic and computational security to evaluate five core LLM capabilities: interpretation, generation, completion, transformation, and correction. It comprises 700 instances spanning 677 schemes, 7 mainstream formal verifier languages, and 160 security properties. The evaluation of 9 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals that most of them perform well on interpretation and completion, given their code-awareness advantages, but struggle with generation, transformation, and correction. Overall, their performance remains limited, with Claude-3.5 achieving the highest score at 48.7 out of 100. We further provide practical guidance, e.g., few-shot prompting, Pass@K sampling, and lightweight fine-tuning, to mitigate the executability bottleneck and improve tool-usable outputs. Taken together, our benchmark and analyses offer a grounded view of current progress and concrete directions toward reliable LLM-assisted formal cryptographic analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 手动对密码学方案进行形式化分析是一项劳动密集型工作，需要深厚的专业知识。尽管模型检测工具（如Scyther和Tamarin）以及计算安全工具（如CryptoVerif和EasyCrypt）提高了安全证明的自动化程度，但它们仍然依赖专家对方案进行抽象并编写特定于工具的形式化描述。大型语言模型（LLM）是一种有前景的替代方案，但因其在这一领域缺乏标准化评估方法，其有效性尚未得到探索。为填补这一空白，本文提出了CrypFormBench（简称C.F.B），这是一个综合性的基准测试，涵盖符号安全与计算安全，用于评估LLM的五项核心能力：解释、生成、补全、转换和修正。该基准包含700个实例，覆盖677个方案、7种主流形式化验证语言和160个安全属性。对9个最先进的LLM的评估显示，大多数模型在解释和补全任务上表现良好（这得益于其代码理解优势），但在生成、转换和修正任务上表现挣扎。总体而言，它们的性能仍然有限，Claude-3.5以48.7分（满分100）获得最高分。本文进一步提供了实用指导，例如少样本提示、Pass@K采样和轻量级微调，以缓解可执行性瓶颈并提高工具可用的输出。综上所述，该基准测试和分析为LLM辅助形式化密码分析的当前进展提供了具体视角，并为实现可靠辅助指明了方向。本文适合密码学形式化分析研究人员、安全工程师以及对LLM在安全领域应用感兴趣的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准评估了LLM在密码形式化分析中的能力，为安全社区提供了首个标准化评估框架，有助于推动LLM辅助安全证明的发展。

items.why_it_matters: 该基准评估了LLM在密码形式化分析中的能力，为安全社区提供了首个标准化评估框架，有助于推动LLM辅助安全证明的发展。

items.title: Security and Privacy in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: Architectures, Threats, Defenses, and Future Directions for Building Trustworthy Systems
items.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for enhancing large language models with external knowledge. By coupling retrieval mechanisms with generative models, RAG systems improve factual grounding and adaptability across domains. However, integrating retrieval pipelines introduces new security and privacy risks that extend beyond conventional language modeling threats. Sensitive information may be exposed through retrieval indices, query logs, context construction, or federated updates, while adversarial manipulation of knowledge bases can undermine trust in generated outputs. This survey provides a comprehensive examination of privacy and security challenges across RAG systems deployed in centralized, on-device (Micro-RAG), federated, and hybrid paradigms. We present a unified taxonomy of threat surfaces spanning the retrieval, context construction, and generation stages and systematically analyze attack classes, including membership inference, index inference, poisoning, gradient leakage, and collusion. We further review architectural, algorithmic, and cryptographic defenses, highlighting privacy-utility trade-offs and deployment considerations. Finally, we outline open research challenges toward building trustworthy, secure, and resilient RAG systems for real-world applications.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该综述论文系统性地探讨了检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的安全与隐私挑战。RAG通过将检索机制与生成模型相结合，提升了大型语言模型的事实准确性和领域适应性，但同时也引入了检索索引、查询日志、上下文构建和联邦更新等环节的敏感信息泄露风险，以及知识库被恶意篡改导致生成内容可信度下降的威胁。论文将RAG系统分为集中式、设备端（Micro-RAG）、联邦式和混合式四种部署范式，并统一分析了各个范式中存在的隐私和安全威胁面，涵盖检索、上下文构建和生成三个阶段。攻击类别包括成员推理、索引推理、投毒、梯度泄漏和合谋攻击等。此外，论文综述了架构、算法和密码学方面的防御措施，强调了隐私-效用权衡和部署考虑。最后，指出了构建可信、安全、弹性的RAG系统面临的开放研究挑战。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: RAG已成为LLM落地的关键技术，但其安全与隐私风险尚未被充分重视。本文为蓝队和安全研究者提供了系统的威胁分类和防御框架，有助于在设计RAG系统时提前识别并缓解风险。

items.title: How Reliable Is Your Jailbreak Judge? Calibration and Adversarial Robustness of Automated ASR Scoring
items.summary: Almost every paper on LLM jailbreaks and prompt injection reports an attack-success rate (ASR), and that number is assigned not by people but by an automated judge: either a safety classifier trained for the task, or a general chat model prompted to grade. The judge is rarely checked. We check it. Using 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set, we compare the two judge families against human majority votes and then attack them. The two families fail in opposite ways. The dedicated classifier over-flags (precision 0.835, recall 0.974); three different LLM-as-judges keep high precision (0.81 to 0.94) but show erratic recall (0.06 to 0.65), so the same responses produce very different ASR depending on which judge scores them. The two families also differ sharply in robustness. Wrappers that leave the harmful text untouched and only add benign framing flip every LLM-judge between 57% and 100% of the time, and a single prepended refusal sentence accounts for much of this (39% to 88%). The dedicated classifier resists these surface attacks (at most 6.7%), but a white-box GCG attack on its open weights flips 70% of confident true positives (21 of 30; 95% CI 54 to 86%) even at a small optimization budget. A two-annotator audit confirms the attacks leave the harm intact: every one of 80 sampled flips still contained the harmful content. Because a large and growing share of reported ASR comes from LLM-judges, many such numbers are unreliable both on average and under deliberate pressure. We recommend that papers report judge precision and recall on a human-labeled slice, report ASR corrected for judge precision, and include an adversarial check of the judge. Our code is released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文对LLM越狱攻击中自动攻击成功率（ASR）评分的可靠性进行了全面评估。目前几乎所有关于LLM越狱和提示注入的论文都依赖自动化裁判（专用安全分类器或通用聊天模型）来报告ASR，但这些裁判本身的准确性很少被验证。作者使用HarmBench分类器验证集中596个人工标注的补全响应，将两类裁判与人类多数投票进行比较，并对裁判实施攻击。实验发现两类裁判以相反的方式失败：专用分类器过度标记（精确率0.835，召回率0.974）；而三种LLM裁判保持高精确率（0.81至0.94），但召回率波动极大（0.06至0.65），导致相同的响应集因裁判不同而得出截然不同的ASR。在鲁棒性方面，包装攻击（仅添加无害框架而不改变有害文本）在57%至100%的情况下翻转了所有LLM裁判，其中单一的前置拒绝语句就造成了39%至88%的翻转。专用分类器抵抗此类表面攻击（最多6.7%翻转），但其开放权重下的白盒GCG攻击在很小的优化预算下翻转了70%的自信真阳性样本。双人审核确认攻击后内容的有害性保持不变。由于很大一部分已报告的ASR来自LLM裁判，许多数值在平均值和刻意压力下都不可靠。论文建议研究者在论文中报告裁判在人工标注切片上的精确率和召回率、报告经裁判精确率校正的ASR，并对裁判进行对抗性检查。代码已开源。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了当前LLM安全评估中自动化ASR评分普遍存在的不可靠性，可能导致大量越狱攻击研究的结论失真，对安全从业者评估LLM防护有效性有重大影响。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响依赖自动ASR裁判的LLM安全评估工作，包括学术界和工业界的越狱攻击研究、红队测试和防御评估；可能导致评估结果偏差，误导安全决策。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：在内部评估流程中验证所使用的自动化裁判的精确率和召回率，并采纳论文建议的裁判校验方法（如人工标注切片校正、对抗性检查）。

items.title: Information flow security on persistent memory
items.summary: Persistent memory is a recently proposed memory paradigm that delivers many system-wide benefits, including improved runtime efficiency and the ability of programs to recover from power outages and system crashes. While recent research has investigated techniques for proving functional correctness of programs running on related architectures, this is not the case for the orthogonal concept of information flow security. In this paper, we provide an information flow logic for an unstructured language (i.e., with gotos rather than loops) modelling a simple assembly language. We apply this logic to x86 assembly using a notion of reordering interference freedom (rif) to reason about potential out-of-order propagation of instructions to memory. We then show how this same notion of rif can be used to similarly reason about information flow on persistent memory.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 持久内存（persistent memory）是一种新兴的内存范式，能够提升系统运行时效率，并支持程序在断电或系统崩溃后恢复。然而，现有研究主要关注这类架构上程序的功能正确性，而忽略了信息流安全这一正交概念。本文针对这一问题，提出了一种面向无结构语言（即使用 goto 而非循环）的信息流逻辑，该语言模拟了简单汇编语言。作者将该逻辑应用于 x86 汇编，并引入了重排序干扰自由（reordering interference freedom, RIF）的概念，以推理指令在内存中的潜在乱序传播行为。通过 RIF，论文展示了如何在持久内存上类似地推理信息流安全性。主要贡献包括：1) 为无结构语言定义信息流逻辑；2) 将逻辑扩展到 x86 汇编，考虑重排序行为；3) 将 RIF 用于持久内存场景。本文适合对持久内存安全、信息流控制以及汇编级安全保障感兴趣的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 持久内存正在被引入实际系统，但其安全性研究不足。本文首次提出针对持久内存架构的信息流安全逻辑，填补了该领域空白，对保障恢复后程序的机密性具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响持久内存场景下的安全验证工具和编译器优化；可迁移至其他非易失内存架构的信息流分析。

items.why_it_matters: 持久内存正在被引入实际系统，但其安全性研究不足。本文首次提出针对持久内存架构的信息流安全逻辑，填补了该领域空白，对保障恢复后程序的机密性具有重要意义。

items.title: Representation Matters: An Empirical Study of Program Representations for LLM Vulnerability Reasoning
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated vulnerability detection, but it remains unclear how program structure and semantics should be represented for LLM-based reasoning. Most prompting-based approaches provide raw source code, implicitly assuming that more source-level context gives the model better evidence. This paper challenges that assumption through RepBench, an empirical benchmark comparing raw source code with static-analysis-based program representations. RepBench converts real-world C/C++ vulnerability testcases into multiple representations: raw source, Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs), Control-Flow Graphs (CFGs), Program Dependence Graphs (PDGs), their combinations, and an auxiliary track of enriched PDGs (ePDGs). Using a curated PrimeVul-derived corpus of 107 Joern-based testcases across five CWE categories, we evaluate ten representation variants under a fixed Chain-of-Thought and structured-output protocol, plus 19 additional ePDG cases generated through VulChecker/Hector. Representation choice substantially affects LLM vulnerability reasoning. The strongest variant, AST+PDG, achieves 83.2% accuracy, compared with 53.5% for raw source. At the family level, graph-only prompts outperform both source-only and source-plus-graph prompts while requiring far less prompt overhead. These results reveal a context dilution effect: adding raw source code to compact structural graph evidence can degrade reasoning by making vulnerability-relevant evidence less salient. Overall, our findings show that carefully selected structural representations offer a better accuracy-overhead tradeoff than simply giving LLMs more raw input, and suggest that static analysis can serve as an effective prompt-construction layer for security-focused LLM reasoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化漏洞检测中的应用，系统研究了不同程序表示对LLM推理能力的影响。当前大多数基于提示的方法直接提供原始源代码，认为更多上下文能提升模型表现。作者通过构建RepBench基准挑战这一假设，该基准将真实世界的C/C++漏洞测试用例转换为多种表示形式：原始源代码、抽象语法树（AST）、控制流图（CFG）、程序依赖图（PDG）、它们的组合，以及增强型PDG（ePDG）。实验采用基于PrimeVul整理的数据集，包含107个Joern生成的测试用例，覆盖5个CWE类别，并在固定思维链和结构化输出协议下评估了10种表示变体，另有19个附加ePDG用例来自VulChecker/Hector。结果表明，表示选择显著影响LLM漏洞推理性能。最强的表示组合AST+PDG达到了83.2%的准确率，而原始源码仅为53.5%。在家族层面，仅依靠图结构的提示优于纯源码提示或源码加图提示，且所需提示开销更少。研究发现存在“上下文稀释”效应：将原始源码添加到紧凑的结构化图证据中，会削弱漏洞相关证据的显著性，导致推理性能下降。总体而言，本文表明精心选择的结构化表示在准确性和开销之间取得了更好的平衡，并建议静态分析可作为面向安全LLM推理的有效提示构建层。该研究为安全从业者设计基于LLM的漏洞检测系统提供了重要指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了程序表示对LLM漏洞推理的关键影响，提示安全从业者不应简单依赖原始源码，而应利用静态分析构建结构化提示以提升检测准确率。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响基于LLM的自动化漏洞检测工具的设计，可迁移到源代码安全审计、静态分析集成等场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 关注该研究方向，在内部评估不同程序表示对LLM漏洞分析的影响。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了程序表示对LLM漏洞推理的关键影响，提示安全从业者不应简单依赖原始源码，而应利用静态分析构建结构化提示以提升检测准确率。

items.title: General Techniques for Reducing Key-Switching Overhead in Privacy-Preserving Two-Party Transformer Inference
items.summary: In secure two-party Transformer inference, linear layers are typically evaluated using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) through plaintext-ciphertext or ciphertext-ciphertext matrix multiplications, where key switching primarily occurs and dominates computational overhead in both FHE-based and hybrid FHE-MPC systems. Existing optimizations rely heavily on packing-specific algorithms, limiting their general applicability. Targeting this overhead from a packing-independent perspective, we propose a preprocessing-assisted method for secure attention computation. By decomposing attention into precomputable operations and online interactions, this method reduces online inference-phase key switching without modifying existing packing strategies. However, the first method shifting key switching offline introduces additional storage requirements. To address this, we propose storage-communication trade-off techniques that replace large precomputed ciphertexts with modest online communication, enabling flexible deployment under varying resource constraints. While ciphertext-ciphertext matrix multiplication is offloaded to the preprocessing phase in hybrid schemes and the first layer of FHE-based schemes, these operations still persist in the offline stage and subsequent FHE layers. To further optimize it, we propose a fused key-switch technique targeting the multiplication-followed-by-rotation pattern, which frequently arises in existing RNS-CKKS matrix multiplication schemes. By combining relinearization and rotation into a single procedure, this technique reduces the associated computation costs. Analytical evaluations demonstrate that our proposed techniques significantly reduce online key-switch overhead and provide flexible trade-offs between storage and communication without requiring modifications to existing packing strategies.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对安全两方Transformer推理中的性能瓶颈——密钥切换（key switching）开销——提出了一系列通用优化技术。在安全两方推理场景下，线性层通常通过全同态加密（FHE）以明文-密文或密文-密文矩阵乘法方式评估，其中密钥切换操作主要发生在此处，并主导了FHE及FHE-MPC混合系统的计算开销。现有优化方法多依赖于特定的打包（packing）策略，通用性受限。为解决此问题，作者首先从独立于打包策略的视角出发，提出了一种预处理辅助的安全注意力计算方法。该方法将注意力计算分解为可预计算操作和在线交互，从而在不修改现有打包策略的前提下减少在线推理阶段的密钥切换次数。然而，将密钥切换离线化会引入额外的存储需求。为此，作者提出了存储-通信权衡技术，利用适度的在线通信替代大型预计算密文，使得方案可在不同资源约束下灵活部署。进一步地，在混合方案和基于FHE的方案的第一个层中，密文-密文矩阵乘法被卸载到预处理阶段，但后续层仍存在此类操作。为优化此问题，作者针对现有RNS-CKKS矩阵乘法方案中频繁出现的“乘法后接旋转”模式，提出了一种融合密钥切换技术（fused key-switch technique），将重线性化（relinearization）与旋转合并为单一过程，显著降低了相关计算开销。分析评估表明，所提技术显著降低了在线密钥切换开销，并在不修改现有打包策略的前提下提供了存储与通信的灵活权衡。该研究为隐私保护机器学习中的效率优化提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Transformer模型推理的隐私保护是实际应用中的关键需求，但FHE的高开销阻碍了落地。本文提出的通用密钥切换优化技术不依赖于特定打包策略，可直接应用于现有安全推理系统，显著提升性能，对隐私计算领域具有实际参考价值。

items.title: Decoupling Reconnaissance and Exploitation: Measuring the Capability Boundaries of LLM-Based Web Penetration Testing
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for automated penetration testing, yet existing end-to-end black-box evaluations are highly susceptible to error cascading: failures in early reconnaissance can mask an agent's actual ability to exploit vulnerabilities. To more accurately characterize these capabilities, we propose a two-stage decoupled evaluation framework that separates exploit execution from reconnaissance. Using ground-truth injection and knowledge-driven ablation across 70 high-fidelity web vulnerability testbeds, our framework isolates exploitation performance from reconnaissance noise. We empirically evaluate five open-source penetration-testing agents, covering multiagent, monolithic, and graph-driven architectures, on a strictly aligned subset of 50 representative vulnerabilities. The results reveal a substantial capability gap. With accurate vulnerability context, agents achieve a functional success rate of up to 90.0%, whereas autonomous reconnaissance, measured by targeted vulnerability recall, plateaus at approximately 50.0%, primarily due to failures in parsing unstructured telemetry. Cross-architectural analysis further reveals distinct capability niches: multi-agent isolation is more effective for long-sequence interactions such as de-serialization, while monolithic and graph-driven designs perform better on short-chain injections and cross-session access-control vulnerabilities, respectively. This decoupled evaluation work provides a fine-grained benchmarking protocol and an empirical basis for designing next-generation automated offensive security agents.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化渗透测试中展现出潜力，但现有端到端黑盒评估容易受到错误级联的影响：早期侦察阶段的失败可能掩盖代理实际利用漏洞的能力。为了更准确地刻画这些能力，本文提出了一种两阶段解耦评估框架，将利用执行与侦察分离。通过使用真实漏洞注入和基于知识的消融实验，在 70 个高保真 Web 漏洞测试平台上，该框架能够从侦察噪声中隔离出利用性能。研究评估了五种开源渗透测试代理，涵盖多智能体、单体和图驱动架构，在严格对齐的 50 个代表性漏洞子集上进行了实验。结果表明存在显著的能力差距：当提供准确的漏洞上下文时，代理的功能成功率高达 90.0%；而自主侦察（通过目标漏洞召回率衡量）仅达到约 50.0%，主要原因是无法解析非结构化遥测数据。跨架构分析进一步揭示了不同的能力特征：多智能体隔离对于长序列交互（如反序列化）更有效，而单体和图驱动设计分别在短链注入和跨会话访问控制漏洞上表现更好。该解耦评估工作为自动化攻防代理的设计提供了细粒度的基准测试协议和经验基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了 LLM 在自动化渗透测试中的关键能力瓶颈在于侦察而非利用，为安全从业者理解 LLM 代理的局限性提供了实证数据，有助于指导更有效的自动化安全测试工具研发。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该研究框架可作为评估 LLM 驱动渗透测试代理的标准化方法，其发现对提升自动化攻击模拟工具的侦察能力具有直接指导意义，并可迁移至其他安全评估场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将论文中的解耦评估方法纳入内部自动化安全测试工具能力的评估流程，重点关注侦察能力的改进。

items.title: Sponsored Group Signature and its Application to Privacy-preserving Guest Access in Smart Environments
items.summary: Group signatures are privacy preserving signature schemes in which a group member can anonymously sign messages on behalf of the group, while providing accountability, by allowing the signature of a misbehaving group member be ``opened'' and the identity of the signer be revealed. In group signature members are admitted to the group by a (trusted) group manager. We motivate the need for a flexible mechanism in applications, such as privacy preserving access in smart environments, and propose a two-level member-join group signature that we call SPonsored Group Signature (SPGS) where group members of level 1 can ``sponsor'' new members, in level 2, to join the group. This relaxation of user join comes with additional accountability mechanisms: we require that the signature of a sponsored member can be opened to the identity of the sponsor (that is sponsor is responsible for the sponsored member), and while all signatures are anonymous, for the sponsored members, the signatures are linkable. This allows a sponsor to efficiently identify an undesirable sponsored member. We formalize SPGS scheme, define its security using a game-based approach, and give a generic construction of SPGS that uses a (dynamic) group signature scheme, a commitment scheme, and a knowledge-sound non-interactive zero knowledge proof of knowledge, and prove its security. We also give an instantiation of our construction. To show applicability of SPGS in practice, we consider the problem of providing guest access in a smart building, and introduce Anonymous Guest Access Token (AGAT) that allows a temporary guest to anonymously access (a subset of) the building resources. We show how SPGS can be used (together with an IND-CPA secure public key encryption scheme) to give a direct construction for AGAT, and show the efficiency of our guest access protocol when it is instantiated with existing schemes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种新颖的群签名变体——赞助群签名（SPGS），旨在解决智能环境（如智能建筑）中需要灵活成员加入机制的场景。传统群签名中，所有成员只能由群管理员统一添加，缺乏灵活性。SPGS引入了两级成员结构：第一级成员（赞助者）有权赞助第二级成员（被赞助者）加入群组，同时增加了两层问责机制：1) 被赞助者签名可被打开以揭示赞助者身份，确保赞助者对被赞助者的行为负责；2) 被赞助者的签名之间具有可链接性，允许赞助者高效识别不受欢迎的被赞助者，而所有签名对第三方保持匿名。论文形式化定义了SPGS及其安全性（采用基于游戏的方法），给出了一个通用构造，该构造结合了动态群签名方案、承诺方案以及知识可靠的非交互零知识证明（NIZK PoK），并证明了安全性。此外，论文还提供了一个基于具体方案的实例化。为了展示实用性，论文将SPGS应用于智能建筑中的访客匿名访问问题，提出了匿名访客访问令牌（AGAT），允许临时访客匿名访问建筑资源的子集。AGAT的构造使用SPGS结合IND-CPA安全的公钥加密方案。实验评估表明，该协议在现有方案实例化下具有可接受的效率。本文主要贡献：提出SPGS新概念及安全模型，给出通用构造与实例化，并展示了在隐私保护访客控制中的有效应用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 赞助群签名为需要灵活、自治成员加入的隐私保护场景（如智能建筑访客管理、企业合作群组）提供了理论框架，其可链接性和双重问责机制平衡了匿名性和责任追究，对设计实际隐私保护系统具有指导意义。

items.title: Homomorphic Encryptions for Privacy Preserving Vision
items.summary: Legal requirements might prevent organizations from sharing sensitive data like medical or financial details of consumers which prevents them from leveraging cloud based ML-as-a-service solutions provided by third party providers, which are quickly gaining popularity these days. In this project, we aim to perform inference tasks in Computer Vision in a privacy-preserving manner, i.e, by only looking at encrypted data. Recent advances in fully homomorphic encryption make this possible. A fully homomorphic encryption allows an arbitrary sequence of additive and multiplicative operations to be performed on encrypted data directly. Applying homomorphic encryptions to CNNs requires modifying the conventional CNN layers, so that they adhere to the encryption scheme. Our aim was to explore the best methods to create CNNs which can classify encrypted images directly. We used Microsoft SEAL for performing homomorphic encryption. The performance of these "encryption based CNNs" should be comparable with baseline accuracies of the same CNNs trained on unencrypted data, and the aim was to achieve as low of a hit on inference-time performance as possible. We successfully obtained minimal drop in classification accuracy for various datasets. We used MNIST as our baseline, which is popularly used in related research work and then explored more complex datasets like Kuzushiji MNIST, Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 as a part of our contribution. Additionally, we also added support for more complex operations on top of TenSEAL, like processing colored images (multi-channel input), applying multiple convolutional layers and performing average pooling.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了在同态加密（FHE）框架下实现计算机视觉推理任务的方法，以解决隐私保护问题。由于法律限制，组织无法将敏感数据（如医疗或金融记录）发送给第三方ML服务提供商，因此需要一种能在加密数据上直接进行推理的技术。论文利用微软SEAL库实现全同态加密，并修改传统卷积神经网络（CNN）层以适应加密方案，从而构建能够直接对加密图像进行分类的CNN模型。主要贡献包括：1）在MNIST、Kuzushiji MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上实现了与未加密基线相近的分类精度；2）在TenSEAL基础上增加了对多通道输入（彩色图像）、多个卷积层和平均池化的支持，扩展了加密CNN的处理能力；3）优化了推理时间性能，尽可能降低加密带来的额外开销。实验结果表明，分类精度下降非常小，证明了该方法在隐私保护视觉任务中的有效性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究为在敏感数据上安全使用云ML服务提供了可行方案，对于医疗、金融等隐私敏感行业具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何需要隐私保护推理的计算机视觉场景，如医学影像分析、人脸识别、监控视频处理等。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究为在敏感数据上安全使用云ML服务提供了可行方案，对于医疗、金融等隐私敏感行业具有重要参考价值。

items.title: SoK: AI Secure Code Generation: Progress, Pitfalls, and Paths Forward
items.summary: The increasing use of AI systems for code generation raises a central security question: what can today's models and coding agents actually do to produce secure code, where do they still fail, and what would move the field forward? Existing work has explored prompting, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and agentic workflows for secure code generation, but the field still lacks a systematic understanding of how these techniques improve security and why substantial failures persist. In this SoK, we systematize the progress, pitfalls, and paths forward for AI secure code generation. We introduce a three-level framework that measures models' natural-language understanding of secure coding principles, their code-level actuation of those principles during generation, and the knowledge--actuation gaps between the two. We instantiate this framework across models and coding agents on benchmarks covering both isolated function-level security and full web-application security. Our results show that secure-coding-principle understanding is a statistically strong predictor of code-level outcomes, including functional correctness, security, and joint functional-security correctness. Yet substantial knowledge--actuation gaps remain: models can recognize relevant security principles but still fail to translate them into secure and functional code. These findings offer a principle-centered account of where AI secure code generation stands today and identify concrete paths forward through principle-guided generation, evaluation, benchmarking, and agentic workflows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文是首篇系统化综述（SoK），旨在回答当前AI代码生成模型在安全代码生成方面究竟能做什么、仍然失败在哪里以及未来如何前进。作者提出了一个三级分析框架：第一级测量模型对安全编码原则的自然语言理解能力；第二级测量模型在生成代码时实际应用这些原则的能力；第三级量化两者之间的知识-执行差距（knowledge–actuation gap）。该框架被应用于多种主流大语言模型（如GPT系列、Codex等）和编码代理（coding agents），在两类基准测试（独立函数级安全与完整Web应用安全）上进行评估。主要发现包括：安全编码原则理解能力是代码级结果（功能正确性、安全性、功能-安全联合正确性）的统计显著预测因子；然而，即使模型能够识别相关安全原则，在生成既安全又功能正确的代码时仍存在显著的执行差距。基于这些发现，论文提供了以原则为中心的现状评估，并指出了通过原则引导生成、评估、基准设计和代理工作流等具体前进路径。适合AI安全研究者、大模型开发者和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统化揭示LLM在安全代码生成中“知道但做不到”的普遍现象，为设计更有效的安全评估和训练方法提供了理论框架。

items.why_it_matters: 首次系统化揭示LLM在安全代码生成中“知道但做不到”的普遍现象，为设计更有效的安全评估和训练方法提供了理论框架。

items.title: Speculative Decoding at Temperature Zero: A Scoped Safety-Invariance Screen with a 48,072-Sample Expansion
items.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by letting a draft model propose tokens for a target model to verify, raising a concrete safety question: at temperature zero, can draft-side behavior leak into safety-scored outputs? We answer with Typical-Acceptance Invariance Screen (TAIS), a behavioral-equivalence screen that pairs target-only and speculative outputs on the same safety battery and requires byte-identity evidence, TOST equivalence at +/-3pp, and per-task Cohen's h below a calibrated null cutoff of |h| < 0.1. Applied to a 16,783-sample confirmatory core plus 44,066 matched expansion samples (fp16/bf16 execution, canonical and DPO-adversarial drafts, GPTQ-4bit drafts, two seeds, and four safety benchmarks), the tested temperature-zero vLLM stacks show no detectable safety divergence under TAIS. The largest absolute Cohen's h on matched target-only versus speculative refusal is 0.024, roughly an order of magnitude below the conventional trivial-effect floor; 25 of 27 per-task TOST contrasts pass at the +/-3pp margin (the two non-pass contrasts are capability-domain Wald-CI edge cases at identical ceiling rates, not genuine non-equivalence); the DPO-adversarial draft produces byte-identical output to the canonical draft across 4,006 samples; and bf16 changes 36%-53% of output bytes without moving any per-task safety rate outside equivalence. A separate 4,006-sample 70B production-scale probe, which lacks a matched 70B target-only arm and is therefore not counted as a TAIS pass, produces AdvBench refusal 0.839 over 700 AdvBench completions with 95% Wilson CI [0.809, 0.864]. We make no claim about sampling temperatures, untested frameworks, untested model families, or tree-speculation variants such as EAGLE and Medusa.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对推测解码（Speculative Decoding）在温度为零（temperature zero）时的安全不变性问题进行了系统性研究。推测解码通过让一个草稿模型（draft model）生成候选 token，再由目标模型（target model）验证，从而加速推理。这引发了一个具体的安全问题：在确定性采样（温度=0）下，草稿模型的行为是否可能泄漏到安全评分输出中？作者提出了典型接受不变性筛选（Typical-Acceptance Invariance Screen, TAIS），这是一种行为等价性筛选方法。TAIS 要求在同一安全测试集上配对纯目标模型输出和推测解码输出，并同时满足以下三个条件：（1）字节完全相同性证据；（2）TOST（双单侧检验）等价性在 +/-3 个百分点范围内；（3）每项任务的 Cohen's h 值低于校准的零假设截止值 |h| < 0.1。实验基于一个 16,783 样本的确认核心加上 44,066 匹配扩展样本（涵盖 fp16/bf16 执行、标准草稿与 DPO 对抗草稿、GPTQ-4bit 草稿、两种随机种子以及四个安全基准）。测试结果显示，在 TAIS 标准下，所有被测试的温度为零的 vLLM 推理栈均未检测到可分离的安全差异。纯目标模型与推测解码在拒绝率上的最大绝对 Cohen's h 值为 0.024，约比常规的微小效应阈值低一个数量级；27 项任务中的 25 项 TOST 对比在 +/-3% 的边界内通过（另外两项不通过的对比是能力域中相同天花板率下的 Wald-CI 边界情况，并非真正的非等价）；DPO 对抗草稿在 4,006 个样本上与标准草稿产生字节完全相同的输出；bf16 改变了 36%-53% 的输出字节，但没有将任何任务的安全率移出等价范围。此外，一项单独的 4,006 样本 70B 生产规模探测（由于缺乏匹配的 70B 纯目标对照，因此不视为 TAIS 通过）在 700 个 AdvBench 补全上产生拒绝率 0.839，95% Wilson 置信区间 [0.809, 0.864]。作者声明该结论不适用于其他采样温度、未经测试的框架、未经测试的模型家族或树形推测变体（如 EAGLE 和 Medusa）。该研究为推测解码在零温度下的安全等价性提供了统计严谨的实证证据，并提出了一套可复用的安全性筛选流程。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统性地验证了推测解码在零温度下对安全评分的影响，提供了统计严谨的测试方法论。对于追求推理加速而不妥协安全性的 LLM 部署具有直接参考价值，尤其适合安全工程师和 AI 基础设施团队评估推测解码的风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 实验验证的方法论可迁移到其他推理加速技术（如投机性采样变体）或安全对齐测试场景，帮助量化加速技术对安全性的影响。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究首次系统性地验证了推测解码在零温度下对安全评分的影响，提供了统计严谨的测试方法论。对于追求推理加速而不妥协安全性的 LLM 部署具有直接参考价值，尤其适合安全工程师和 AI 基础设施团队评估推测解码的风险。

items.title: What Does It Mean to Break a Distillation Defense?
items.summary: Black-box LLMs (accessible only via API) are vulnerable to distillation attacks, in which an attacker queries the model and trains a student on its outputs. A recent line of work proposes output perturbation defenses that modify the teacher's output to reduce student performance while preserving utility for legitimate users. As a relatively new family of approaches, output perturbation defenses lack a shared threat model, making it difficult to compare them, reason about composing them with other attacks, or evaluate their robustness against realistic adversaries. This underspecification matters beyond technical evaluation: when defenses are deployed to protect intellectual property or justify regulatory compliance, an imprecise threat model can create a false sense of security. We propose a threat model framework that describes attackers along three dimensions: a query budget, a data budget, and an interface profile that captures how attackers interact with the API. Using antidistillation sampling as a case study, we show that whether the defense is considered effective depends on the assumed threat model. We argue that future work on distillation defenses, along with any governance or policy frameworks built around them, should explicitly specify and stress-test attacker capabilities along our three dimensions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对黑盒大语言模型（LLM）蒸馏攻击的防御问题展开研究。蒸馏攻击是指攻击者通过查询API获取教师模型输出，并训练一个学生模型来模仿其行为。近期研究提出了一系列输出扰动防御方法，即修改教师模型的输出以降低学生模型性能，同时保持对合法用户的可用性。然而，作为一个相对较新的方法族，输出扰动防御缺乏统一的威胁模型，导致难以在不同防御方法之间进行比较、推理如何与其他攻击组合使用，或评估其对现实攻击者的鲁棒性。这种威胁模型的不明确性不仅影响技术评估，更可能在实际部署中造成虚假安全感，例如在保护知识产权或满足合规要求时。为此，作者提出了一个威胁模型框架，从三个维度刻画攻击者：查询预算（攻击者能发起的API查询次数）、数据预算（攻击者能获取的额外数据量，如未标记样本）以及接口配置文件（攻击者与API交互的方式，如采样策略、温度设置等）。以反蒸馏采样（antidistillation sampling）作为案例研究，作者展示了同一防御方法在不同威胁模型下可能被判定为有效或无效。本文的主要贡献在于提供了系统化的威胁模型定义和评估框架，并呼吁未来的蒸馏防御工作（以及围绕其构建的治理或政策框架）应明确指定并压力测试这三个维度的攻击者能力。适合安全研究人员、LLM防御开发者以及政策制定者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 当前LLM蒸馏防御缺乏统一威胁模型，导致评估结果不可比，易产生虚假安全感。本框架为防御的标准化评估提供基础，对保护模型知识产权和合规化部署至关重要。

items.why_it_matters: 当前LLM蒸馏防御缺乏统一威胁模型，导致评估结果不可比，易产生虚假安全感。本框架为防御的标准化评估提供基础，对保护模型知识产权和合规化部署至关重要。

items.title: Certification of Machine Learning Models via Directional Sharpness
items.summary: In machine learning, model certification has been identified as an important method for gaining assurance about a model's trustworthiness and quality. A model's quality is largely determined by its ability to generalize, i.e., to perform well on data beyond what it was trained on. It is not possible to certify generalization directly, however, as it depends on unknown data and is not directly measurable. Proxies such as test accuracy can be misleading when the training process is perturbed (intentionally or accidentally), and metrics such as sharpness -- which has an empirically supported link to generalization -- are computationally expensive and can also serve as unreliable signals when training deviates from a prescribed procedure. In this work, we propose directional sharpness, a metric designed to efficiently and reliably indicate generalization despite potential training deviations. We provide empirical and analytical evidence that directional sharpness (1) correlates more strongly with generalization than existing metrics and (2) identifies models with poor generalization more reliably than existing metrics. Furthermore, directional sharpness is efficiently computable in model auditing settings, where the verifier has access to training data, and via zero-knowledge proofs that certify quality without revealing training data.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 机器学习模型的认证对于确保模型的可信度和质量至关重要。模型的泛化能力（即对未知数据的表现）是衡量其质量的关键，但直接认证泛化能力难以实现，因为它依赖于未知数据且不可直接测量。传统代理指标（如测试准确率）在训练过程受到扰动（有意或无意）时可能产生误导；而经验上与泛化相关的度量（如锐度）计算成本高，且在训练偏离规定流程时也可能提供不可靠信号。本文提出方向锐度（directional sharpness）这一新度量，旨在高效且可靠地指示泛化能力，即使在训练存在偏差的情况下。作者提供了实证和分析证据，表明方向锐度（1）比现有度量与泛化能力有更强的相关性；（2）能比现有度量更可靠地识别泛化能力差的模型。此外，方向锐度在模型审计场景中可高效计算，审计方有权访问训练数据；同时可通过零知识证明实现质量认证，而不泄露训练数据。该工作为模型认证提供了新的工具，适合机器学习安全与隐私领域的研究者及需要验证模型质量的从业者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出方向锐度作为模型泛化能力的可靠指标，解决了现有度量在训练扰动下不可靠的问题，有助于提升机器学习模型认证的效率和可信度，对安全场景中的模型审计具有重要意义。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提出方向锐度作为模型泛化能力的可靠指标，解决了现有度量在训练扰动下不可靠的问题，有助于提升机器学习模型认证的效率和可信度，对安全场景中的模型审计具有重要意义。

items.title: HelpBench: Assessing the Ability of LLMs to Provide Privacy, Safety, and Security Advice
items.summary: This paper introduces HelpBench, a benchmark for assessing whether LLMs are capable of providing accurate help in response to questions about digital privacy, safety, and security. We curated 450 questions representing authentic user situations and developed rubrics for each question to evaluate the factual accuracy and tone of a response. Example questions touch on how to regain access to lost or suspended accounts, how to balance the trade-offs of hardware security keys versus other forms of two-factor authentication, whether a suspicious email is likely a scam, or whether an abuser might be able to track an individual based on their device peripherals. We then developed and applied an auto-rater to evaluate responses from 18 state-of-the-art LLMs. Our results indicate that while models provide high-quality advice (with scores of 82% on average), one in ten responses from models scores less than 65%, reflecting inaccurate and even harmful advice. Addressing these failures is critical for models to serve as trustworthy sources of assistance for digital privacy, safety, and security needs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 HelpBench 基准测试，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在提供数字隐私、安全和安全建议方面的能力。研究团队从真实用户场景中筛选了450个问题，涵盖账户恢复、双因素认证选择、可疑邮件识别、设备追踪等典型安全咨询场景，并为每个问题制定了评分标准，同时评估回答的事实准确性和语气。他们开发了自动评分器，对18个最先进的LLM进行了评估。结果显示，模型平均得分82%，表明整体质量较高；但约十分之一的回答得分低于65%，反映了不准确甚至有害的建议。作者强调，要使得LLM成为可信赖的数字隐私、安全和安全援助来源，必须解决这些失败案例。该研究为安全社区提供了评估LLM安全咨询能力的基准，并揭示了当前模型的不足。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM正越来越多地被用作安全咨询工具，但错误建议可能导致用户数据泄露、财产损失或人身安全风险。HelpBench系统性地揭示了当前模型的薄弱环节，对开发更可靠的安全助手至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接适用于依赖LLM提供安全建议的产品（如智能助手、客服系统）；可迁移到其他专业领域（如医疗、法律）的准确性评估场景。

items.why_it_matters: LLM正越来越多地被用作安全咨询工具，但错误建议可能导致用户数据泄露、财产损失或人身安全风险。HelpBench系统性地揭示了当前模型的薄弱环节，对开发更可靠的安全助手至关重要。

items.title: Burnyard: Future of Malware Analysis
items.summary: Malware analysis is a critical aspect of modern cybersecurity. The prevailing industry practice, sandboxing, involves executing suspicious binaries within isolated virtual machines in large-scale data centers. However, this approach can unintentionally expose samples to public platforms such as VirusTotal and MalwareBazaar, and it is both resource-intensive and time-consuming. Burnyard addresses these limitations through a lightweight binary emulation platform that captures observable runtime behavior and records it as structured CSV event traces.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Burnyard 针对当前恶意软件分析中沙箱技术的局限性，提出了一种轻量级二进制模拟平台。沙箱技术在大型数据中心隔离的虚拟机中执行可疑二进制文件，但存在样本意外泄露至 VirusTotal 等公开平台的风险，且资源消耗大、耗时长。Burnyard 通过模拟执行来捕获可观测的运行时行为，并将其记录为结构化的 CSV 事件轨迹。该方法避免了完整系统虚拟化的开销，同时降低了样本暴露风险。论文主要贡献在于设计并实现了这一模拟平台，并展示了其在捕获恶意行为方面的有效性。研究背景强调传统沙箱分析的资源密集性和隐私问题，Burnyard 旨在提供一种更高效、更安全的替代方案。该工作适用于安全分析师和恶意软件研究人员，可作为沙箱分析的补充或轻量级替代品。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一种轻量级恶意软件分析方案，可降低资源开销和样本泄露风险，有望改进现有沙箱实践。

items.why_it_matters: 提供了一种轻量级恶意软件分析方案，可降低资源开销和样本泄露风险，有望改进现有沙箱实践。

items.title: On the Limits of Stretching Quantum Pseudorandomness
items.summary: Pseudorandom states, introduced by Ji, Liu, and Song (CRYPTO '18), are quantum analogues of classical pseudorandom generators. A fundamental property of classical pseudorandom generators is that their output can be stretched to arbitrary polynomial length. Whether an analogous stretching property holds for quantum pseudorandom states remains unclear. In this work, we prove the first black-box separation between single-copy secure pseudorandom states ($\mathsf{1PRS}$) with different output lengths. Specifically, we construct a quantum oracle relative to which $\mathsf{1PRS}$ with output length $m(n)=1.1n$ exist, but $\mathsf{1PRS}$ with output length $m(n)=Ω(n^{2+ε})$ do not, for any $ε>0$. Our proof leverages the Common Haar Random State (CHRS) model introduced by Chen, Coladangelo, and Sattath (EUROCRYPT '25), and introduces a technique to bound the effective number of resource CHRS states utilized by any $\mathsf{1PRS}$ generator in this model.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究量子伪随机态的拉伸性质。经典伪随机生成器的一个重要特性是输出可以拉伸到任意多项式长度，但对于量子伪随机态（尤其是单副本安全的1PRS）是否具备类似性质尚不清楚。作者证明了第一个黑盒分离结果：存在一个量子谕言，使得输出长度为1.1n的1PRS存在，但输出长度为Ω(n^{2+ε})（对任意ε>0）的1PRS不存在。证明利用Chen等人引入的Common Haar Random State (CHRS)模型，并引入了一种技术来限制该模型中任何1PRS生成器实际使用的资源CHRS态的有效数量。该结果揭示了量子伪随机性在拉伸能力上的根本限制，对理解量子密码学中伪随机性的本质具有重要意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 量子伪随机态是量子密码学的基础原语，该结果澄清了其拉伸能力的理论界限，对量子安全协议的设计和分析有指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 理论贡献，主要影响量子密码学领域，可能扩展至量子安全哈希函数或认证方案的设计。

items.why_it_matters: 量子伪随机态是量子密码学的基础原语，该结果澄清了其拉伸能力的理论界限，对量子安全协议的设计和分析有指导意义。

items.title: PowerFuzz: Power-Based Black-Box Firmware Fuzzing
items.summary: Fuzzing is widely used for software and hardware verification, offering an effective alternative to random testing. While gray-box fuzzers benefit from full visibility into the system under test and can leverage execution feedback such as branch coverage, these approaches are not applicable when verifying systems whose firmware or binaries are not publicly available. In such scenarios, obtaining coverage information for guiding the fuzzer becomes infeasible. In this paper, we introduce PowerFuzz, a statistical black-box fuzzing framework that leverages power side-channel measurements as a substitute for binary instrumentation, requiring no internal visibility into the target firmware. A central challenge in black-box firmware fuzzing is determining the executed branches during test execution. To address this challenge, we use power traces to identify branches utilizing a sliding window followed by a growing window full-trace correlation method. This approach also enables the construction of a high-level control-flow graph of the black-box firmware, which we utilize to drive the fuzzer to unexplored execution paths. Extensive evaluation using three embedded hardware platforms and ten firmware benchmarks demonstrates that PowerFuzz can provide branch coverage comparable (within 13.5%) to gray-box fuzzers while significantly outperforming (up to 22%) state-of-the-art black-box fuzzers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 固件模糊测试是发现嵌入式系统漏洞的重要方法，但现有灰盒模糊测试需要目标固件的源码或二进制可见性，而许多商用或专有固件并不公开，使得获得分支覆盖率等执行反馈变得不可行。本文提出 PowerFuzz，一种基于功耗侧信道的统计黑盒固件模糊测试框架，利用功耗轨迹来替代二进制插桩，无需对目标固件有任何内部可见性。核心挑战在于黑盒环境下如何确定测试执行中经过的分支。PowerFuzz 采用滑动窗口加增长窗口的全轨迹相关方法，从功耗轨迹中识别分支，并据此构建黑盒固件的高层控制流图，从而引导模糊器探索未覆盖的执行路径。在三个嵌入式硬件平台和十个固件基准上的广泛评估表明，PowerFuzz 能够提供与灰盒模糊器相当的分支覆盖率（相差 13.5% 以内），同时显著优于最先进的黑盒模糊器（最高提升 22%）。该研究为无法获得固件源码或二进制时的安全测试提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 黑盒固件模糊测试是工业界安全评估的常见痛点，PowerFuzz 仅利用功耗信号即可达到接近灰盒的覆盖率，为闭源固件漏洞挖掘提供了实用的替代方案。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可直接应用于物联网、工控设备等嵌入式系统的安全性测试，降低对固件源码的依赖。

items.why_it_matters: 黑盒固件模糊测试是工业界安全评估的常见痛点，PowerFuzz 仅利用功耗信号即可达到接近灰盒的覆盖率，为闭源固件漏洞挖掘提供了实用的替代方案。

items.title: FirmCure:Towards Autonomous and Adaptive Rehosting of Linux-Based Firmware
items.summary: Full-system rehosting plays a critical role in the security analysis of Linux-based firmware. It matches commonly deployed firmware with sufficient background knowledge. However, for custom devices, existing approaches struggle to handle initialization and runtime obstacles in the rehosting process caused by specialized architectures and hardware-dependent configuration, which heavily rely on expert intervention. This ultimately creates fundamental bottlenecks and results in low rehosting efficiency. To address the above challenges, we propose FirmCure, the first LLM-driven full-system rehosting framework designed for autonomous and adaptive rehosting of Linux-based firmware. FirmCure develops an Adaptive Perception Inference mechanism to extract firmware structural dependencies via static analysis, followed by a Reflective Synthesis module for iterative configuration optimization, and finally an Autonomous Runtime Intervention module for real-time error remediation through runtime fault diagnosis and monitoring. We evaluated 21 IoT firmware images from 10 vendors across 5 architectures, while FirmCure achieved a 100% network port opening rate and 90.5% service interactivity, substantially outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Our experiments confirm that FirmCure's intervention strategies generalize across heterogeneous firmware. The framework successfully reproduces known vulnerabilities and discovers new security flaws.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出FirmCure，首个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的全系统固件重托管框架，旨在实现Linux固件的自主、自适应重托管。固件重托管是安全分析的基础，但现有方法高度依赖专家干预，难以处理定制化设备的初始化与运行时障碍。FirmCure通过三个核心模块应对挑战：自适应感知推理（Adaptive Perception Inference）模块利用静态分析提取固件结构依赖；反思合成（Reflective Synthesis）模块通过迭代优化配置；自主运行时干预（Autonomous Runtime Intervention）模块进行实时错误诊断与修复。在来自10个厂商、5种架构的21个IoT固件镜像上评估，FirmCure实现了100%的网络端口开放率和90.5%的服务交互性，显著优于现有基线。实验表明其干预策略可泛化至异构固件，并能成功复现已知漏洞及发现新的安全缺陷。该工作为自动化固件安全分析提供了新范式，尤其适用于大规模物联网环境。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 固件重托管是漏洞挖掘的关键前置步骤，但手工干预瓶颈严重。FirmCure利用LLM实现自动化，显著提升效率与可扩展性，对安全分析师、固件测试团队具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升固件重托管的自动化程度，可迁移至其他嵌入式系统安全分析场景，如路由器、智能家居设备等。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估纳入内部固件安全测试流水线

items.title: Red-Teaming the Agentic Red-Team
items.summary: The use of agentic systems to perform offensive security operations has moved from a theoretical possibility to a commoditized capability. However, while the community has focused on creating more and more capable agents, less attention has been allocated to assessing the security of those systems. In this work, we present the first in-depth security analysis of the most widely used agentic systems for offensive security operations. We show that most of these tools share common design flaws that enable an active adversary to exfiltrate API keys, establish persistent footholds, and fully compromise the operator's machine, even when the agent operates inside a sandboxed container. To support our analysis, we introduce a full cyber kill chain for such agentic systems, capturing the progression from initial LLM manipulation to lateral movement, persistence, guardrail bypass, and sandbox escape. Building on our security analysis, we derive a robust architecture for agentic offensive-security tools and propose actionable, broadly applicable design principles that mitigate the disclosed attack paths at the architectural level.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次对当前广泛用于红队（进攻性安全操作）的智能体系统进行了深度安全分析。研究发现，尽管社区致力于提升这些智能体的攻击能力，但对其自身安全性的评估却严重不足。作者指出，大多数红队智能体工具存在共同的设计缺陷，使得活跃的攻击者能够窃取API密钥、建立持久化后门，并完全控制操作员的机器——即使智能体运行在沙箱容器内。为了系统化地描述这些威胁，论文提出了一个针对此类智能体系统的完整网络杀伤链模型，涵盖从初始的LLM操控到横向移动、持久化、防护绕过以及沙箱逃逸的各个阶段。基于安全分析，作者推导出一种稳健的红队智能体架构，并提出可落地的、广泛适用的设计原则，从架构层面缓解所披露的攻击路径。该研究为红队智能体的安全防御提供了重要的理论指导和实践建议，适合安全研究人员、红队工具开发者以及安全架构师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 红队智能体领域首次系统性的安全分析，揭示了现有工具的设计缺陷和攻击路径，对于保护红队基础设施和人员安全具有直接指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响红队智能体工具的设计与部署安全性；提出的kill chain模型可推广至其他基于LLM的智能体安全评估。

items.why_it_matters: 红队智能体领域首次系统性的安全分析，揭示了现有工具的设计缺陷和攻击路径，对于保护红队基础设施和人员安全具有直接指导意义。

items.title: Discrepancy for Random Linear Codes
items.summary: We prove that random linear codes have nearly optimal discrepancy properties in a broad range of regimes. Our main results are two general theorems: one controlling all translates of a fixed test, and another controlling large families of Fourier-pseudorandom tests. Two motivating applications follow. First, random linear codes match unstructured random codes for list-decoding from errors above capacity. If $C\subseteq\mathbb F_q^n$ is a random linear code of rate $1-\frac1n\log_q |B_ρ|+ε$, where $B_ρ$ is a radius-$ρ$ Hamming ball, then with high probability $$ |C\cap B|=(1\pm o(1))\frac{|C||B|}{q^n} $$ simultaneously for all radius-$ρ$ Hamming balls $B\subseteq\mathbb F_q^n$. This extends the classical result that such codes have covering radius at most $ρn$ whp (Blinovsky, 1987). Second, over prime fields, random linear codes match unstructured random codes for zero-error list-recovery above capacity. For prime $q>2$ and $2\le \ell\le q-1$, a random linear code of rate $1-\log_q\ell+ε$ satisfies, with high probability, $$ |C\cap S|=(1\pm o(1))\frac{|C|\ell^n}{q^n} $$ simultaneously for all rectangles $S=S_1\times\cdots\times S_n$ with $|S_i|=\ell$. As a consequence, there are abundant $n$-party linear ramp secret sharing schemes over $\mathbb F_q$ with privacy threshold about $n/(2\log q)$ and reconstruction threshold about $5n/(2\log q)$, resilient to balanced local leakage; prior existence results required thresholds above $n/2$ even in this case. The translate result, hence the list-decoding application, holds over arbitrary finite fields, even growing with $n$. The list-recovery and leakage applications hold over prime fields under moderate growth, e.g. $q\le n^{1/5-o(1)}$. The proofs use a refined second-moment analysis tracking intersection sizes as random generators are added to $C$.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文证明随机线性码（random linear codes）在广泛参数范围内具有近乎最优的差异性质（discrepancy properties）。主要结果包括两个一般性定理：第一个定理控制固定测试集的所有平移，第二个定理控制大量傅里叶伪随机测试族。作为应用，首先，随机线性码在超容量纠错（list-decoding）方面与非结构化随机码性能相当：若 C 是 F_q^n 中率为 1 - (1/n) log_q |B_ρ| + ε 的随机线性码（其中 B_ρ 是半径为 ρ 的汉明球），则高概率下对于所有半径为 ρ 的汉明球 B ⊆ F_q^n 同时有 |C ∩ B| = (1 ± o(1)) |C||B|/q^n。这推广了经典结果（Blinovsky, 1987）——此类码覆盖半径至多为 ρn。其次，在素域上，随机线性码在超容量零误差列表恢复方面匹配非结构化随机码：对于素数 q > 2 和 2 ≤ ℓ ≤ q-1，率为 1 - log_q ℓ + ε 的随机线性码高概率下同时满足对所有矩形 S = S_1 × ... × S_n（|S_i| = ℓ）有 |C ∩ S| = (1 ± o(1)) |C| ℓ^n / q^n。推论是存在丰富的 n 方线性斜坡秘密共享方案（over F_q），其隐私阈值约 n/(2 log q)，重建阈值约 5n/(2 log q)，且能抵抗平衡局部泄露；此前即使在该情况下也需要阈值大于 n/2。平移结果（以及列表解码应用）适用于任意有限域（甚至随 n 增长）。列表恢复和泄露应用适用于适度增长的素域，例如 q ≤ n^{1/5-o(1)}。证明使用精细的二阶矩分析，跟踪向 C 添加随机生成元时交集大小的变化。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究从理论上揭示了随机线性码在差异性质上与随机码几乎无差，为列表解码、秘密共享等密码学应用提供了更优的理论保证，对理解线性码的结构和安全性具有重要意义。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究从理论上揭示了随机线性码在差异性质上与随机码几乎无差，为列表解码、秘密共享等密码学应用提供了更优的理论保证，对理解线性码的结构和安全性具有重要意义。

items.title: A Comparison of Kubernetes Compliance Standards and Configuration Scanners
items.summary: Kubernetes has become the industry standard for orchestrating containers in microservice-based software architectures. While several hardening guidelines and scanning tools for securing Kubernetes clusters and deployments have emerged in recent years, their differing guidance and outputs often lead to inconsistent configuration and prioritization decisions. This work presents a systematic comparison of eight commonly used Kubernetes hardening guidelines. Through this comparison and the inclusion of best practices, we established a benchmark of 79 Kubernetes configuration recommendations and conducted the a structured empirical evaluation of ten popular static configuration scanning tools and their scoring outputs. Our findings reveal substantial disparities in the coverage of configuration issues across hardening guidelines and scanners, as well as inconsistencies in how configuration issues are scored and ranked by different scanners. These results highlight the need for more standardized, transparent, and consistent approaches to risk and severity assessment of Kubernetes configuration issues.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统性地比较了八种常用的Kubernetes加固指南和十种流行的静态配置扫描工具。首先，通过对比分析各种加固指南和最佳实践，建立了一个包含79条Kubernetes配置建议的基准。然后，对十个静态配置扫描工具进行了结构化的实证评估，分析其评分输出。研究发现，不同的加固指南和扫描器在配置问题的覆盖范围上存在显著差异，而且不同扫描器对配置问题的评分和排序也存在不一致性。这些结果表明，目前Kubernetes配置问题的风险与严重性评估缺乏标准化、透明度和一致性，亟需改进。该研究为Kubernetes安全实践者提供了选择加固指南和扫描工具的参考依据，并指出了当前生态系统的不足之处。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Kubernetes已成为容器编排的事实标准，但安全加固指南和扫描工具的输出不一致，导致安全团队难以确定优先修复项。本研究系统揭示了这种不一致性，为行业标准化和工具选型提供了重要参考。

items.title: Poisoned Playbooks: Demystifying Knowledge Poisoning Effects on AI Security Agents
items.summary: AI security agents increasingly rely on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to use external security knowledge for vulnerability analysis and exploit reasoning. This creates a new risk: poisoned write-ups can be operationalized into incorrect exploit behavior. Yet, prior work on RAG poisoning has mostly studied answer corruption in QA settings, much less is known about action-taking security agents. This paper aims to reveal such characteristics with crafted poisons about real-world challenges and AI agents. First, we demonstrate how a crafted single poisoned write-up injected into public-style security knowledge sources which we denote as Poisoned Playbooks, alters the behavior of RAG-based AI security agents. Across 11 CTF challenges, 3 frontier LLM families, 2 model generations, and 11 real-world CVEs, we find that poison adoption is systematic rather than random. To explain this pattern, we introduce the Verification Boundary (VB), a 3-level empirical classification based on what evidence the agent can use to refute a retrieved claim. Finally, we evaluate verification prompting and multi-source retrieval, showing that both help when stronger evidence exists, but weaken under sparse-evidence and zero-day conditions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究了针对基于检索增强生成（RAG）的AI安全代理的知识投毒攻击。AI安全代理越来越多地依赖RAG从外部安全知识源（如漏洞报告、CTF题解）获取信息，以进行漏洞分析和利用推理。这种机制引入了新的风险：攻击者可以通过注入精心构造的恶意文本（称为“投毒手册”）来操控代理的行为。作者通过实验验证了这种攻击的有效性：仅需一个单一投毒样本，即可改变RAG代理在11个CTF挑战、3个前沿LLM家族、2代模型以及11个真实CVE上的行为。研究发现，投毒被采纳是系统性的而非随机的。为了解释这一模式，作者提出了“验证边界”（Verification Boundary, VB）的概念，这是一个基于代理能否使用证据反驳检索到的声称的三级经验分类。最后，作者评估了两种防御措施：验证提示（verification prompting）和多源检索（multi-source retrieval），结果表明当存在较强证据时两者均有效，但在证据稀疏或零日条件下效果减弱。本文揭示了AI安全代理在知识投毒下的脆弱性，并提供了新的理论框架和防御思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了RAG安全代理面临的新型知识投毒风险，首次系统研究了对行动型代理的影响，提出了验证边界分类，为防御设计提供理论指导。

items.why_it_matters: 揭示了RAG安全代理面临的新型知识投毒风险，首次系统研究了对行动型代理的影响，提出了验证边界分类，为防御设计提供理论指导。

items.title: ComputeFHE: A Privacy-Preserving General-Purpose Computation Library
items.summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computations to be performed directly on encrypted data while preserving data confidentiality. However, its practical applications remain limited by high computational costs and development complexity. This paper presents ComputeFHE, an open-source C++ library that facilitates the development of privacy-preserving applications based on the TFHE cryptosystem. The library provides encrypted integer and fixed-point data types together with arithmetic, logical, comparison, conditional, and oblivious array-access operations which allow developers to implement algorithms using a familiar imperative programming paradigm. ComputeFHE supports both conventional TFHE arithmetic based on standard two-input logic gates and an optimized Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) architecture utilizing FHE-friendly logic primitives. Experimental results demonstrate significant reductions in the number of required bootstrapping operations, achieving performance improvements of up to 3.9x for selected operations. In addition, the library includes a simulation mode that enables testing, debugging, and complexity analysis without performing actual cryptographic computations while providing circuit complexity and bootstrapping costs. Built on top of OpenFHE, ComputeFHE offers a practical and accessible framework for developing and evaluating privacy-preserving algorithms and applications.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文介绍了 ComputeFHE，一个基于 TFHE 密码系统的开源 C++ 库，旨在简化全同态加密（FHE）应用的开发。FHE 允许在加密数据上直接进行计算，但实际应用受限于高昂的计算成本和开发复杂性。ComputeFHE 提供了加密整数和定点数据类型，以及算术、逻辑、比较、条件判断和无感知数组访问操作，使开发者能够使用熟悉的命令式编程范式实现算法。该库支持基于标准二输入逻辑门的传统 TFHE 算术，以及利用 FHE 友好逻辑原语的优化算术逻辑单元（ALU）架构。实验结果表明，该优化显著减少了所需的自举（bootstrapping）操作次数，选定操作性能提升高达 3.9 倍。此外，ComputeFHE 包含一个模拟模式，可在不执行实际密码计算的情况下进行测试、调试和复杂度分析，同时提供电路复杂度和自举成本估算。该库基于 OpenFHE 构建，为开发和评估隐私保护算法及应用提供了一个实用且易用的框架。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 全同态加密是数据隐私保护的关键技术，但开发门槛高、性能瓶颈大。ComputeFHE 通过优化 ALU 架构和提供高级编程接口，显著降低了 FHE 应用的开发难度并提升了性能，对隐私计算领域具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要保护数据隐私的云计算、数据分析、机器学习推理等场景，尤其是对加密数据执行复杂逻辑的应用。

items.title: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees
items.summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory, which creates a critical vulnerability that we study here: memory poisoning. An adversary can store untrusted content in one session that later steers a consequential action, such as a payment, a setting change, or data exfiltration, in a future session. Existing defenses base a memory item's authority to act on either its content (detection or trust-scoring) or its derivation history (lineage). We show that both signals are malleable. An attacker can launder an untrusted origin through three channels specific to LLM agents: the agent's own summarization, a trusted-tool echo, and manufactured corroboration. Each makes the content look benign and breaks or flips its derivation edge to ``trusted.'' We formalize malleability for the memory write-retrieve-act pipeline and prove a machine-checked separation theorem. No content- or lineage-based defense is sound under laundering (T1), write-time origin binding is necessary (T2), and non-malleable origin-bound authority with Sybil-resistant corroboration-gated elevation is sufficient (T3). Our construction, TMA-NM (Tamper-evident Memory Authority, Non-Malleable), instantiates non-malleable information-flow control (IFC) for LLM-agent memory. A cross-defense, cross-attack, and cross-model benchmark over eight frontier models shows that existing defenses fail exactly where the theory predicts (up to 68% laundering attack-success), while TMA-NM reaches 0% attack success on both direct and laundering attacks across all models and channels, at full legitimate utility. We release the benchmark, harness, and machine-checked TLA+ models to support reproducibility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了LLM智能体长期记忆面临的关键安全漏洞：记忆投毒。攻击者可以在一个会话中存储恶意内容，影响后续会话中的关键操作（如支付、设置更改、数据窃取）。现有防御机制基于内容（检测或信任评分）或衍生历史（谱系）来判定记忆项的权限，但本文证明这两类信号都是可塑的。攻击者可以通过三种针对LLM智能体的渠道清洗恶意来源：智能体自身的摘要、可信工具的反馈、以及伪造的佐证，使内容看似良性并改变其衍生关系为“可信”。本文形式化定义了记忆写入-检索-操作流水线的可塑性，并证明了机器验证的分离定理：在清洗攻击下，任何基于内容或谱系的防御都不安全；写入时绑定来源是必要的；非可塑的、基于来源的权限控制加上抗Sybil的佐证门控提升是充分的。作者提出了TMA-NM（防篡改记忆权限，非可塑）构建，将非可塑信息流控制（IFC）实例化到LLM智能体记忆中。在8个前沿模型上的跨防御、跨攻击、跨模型基准测试显示，现有防御在理论预测的位置完全失败（清洗攻击成功率高达68%），而TMA-NM在所有模型和攻击渠道上达到0%攻击成功率，且保持完全合法效用。论文发布了基准测试、工具链和机器验证的TLA+模型以支持可复现性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体的长时记忆投毒是新兴且严重的威胁，现有防御存在根本性缺陷。本文提出了首个具有形式化保证的防御框架，对构建安全的智能体系统具有里程碑意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖长期记忆的LLM智能体应用，如个人助理、自动化工作流、企业级对话系统。攻击可导致经济损失、数据泄露或权限滥用。

items.title: AutoSpec: Safety Rule Evolution for LLM Agents via Inductive Logic Programming
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate complex tasks by integrating language models with external tools and environments. However, their autonomy poses significant safety risks: agents may execute destructive commands, leak sensitive data, or violate domain constraints. Existing safety approaches face a fundamental tradeoff: hand-crafted rules are interpretable but brittle, with overly conservative rules blocking safe operations (high false positives) while permissive rules miss unsafe behaviors (high false negatives). Neural classifiers lack the interpretability required for safety-critical deployments. We present AutoSpec, a framework that automatically evolves deployed expert-designed safety rules from user safe/unsafe annotations through counterexample-guided inductive synthesis (CEGIS) guided by inductive logic programming (ILP). Starting from the expert rules and a stream of annotated traces, AutoSpec iteratively evaluates rules, mines false-positive and false-negative counterexamples, uses ILP to learn which predicates discriminate them, generates candidate rule edits, and verifies candidates to select the best revision. The key insight is that ILP efficiently identifies predicates that appear frequently in false negatives but rarely in false positives (or vice versa), dramatically pruning the exponential search space of rule edits. This continues until convergence, producing interpretable rules that balance precision and recall. We evaluate AutoSpec on 291 execution traces spanning code execution and embodied agent domains. AutoSpec raises rule F1 to 0.98 and 0.93 across the two domains, achieving up to 94% false positive reduction while maintaining high recall, and converges within 4-5 iterations. The ILP-guided approach achieves up to 4.8x higher F1 than heuristic CEGIS. The learned rules are human-readable, auditable, and generalize to unseen scenarios.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过整合语言模型与外部工具和环境，日益自动化复杂任务，但其自主性带来显著安全风险：可能执行破坏性命令、泄露敏感数据或违反领域约束。现有安全方法面临基本权衡：手工规则可解释但脆弱，过度保守的规则会阻止安全操作（高误报率），而过宽松的规则会遗漏不安全行为（高漏报率）。神经分类器缺乏安全关键部署所需的可解释性。本文提出 AutoSpec 框架，通过反例引导的归纳综合（CEGIS）和归纳逻辑编程（ILP），从用户的安全/不安全标注中自动演化部署的专家设计的安全规则。从专家规则和带标注的执行轨迹流开始，AutoSpec 迭代评估规则，挖掘误报和漏报反例，使用 ILP 学习哪些谓词能区分它们，生成候选规则编辑，并验证候选规则以选择最佳修订版本。关键洞察在于，ILP 能高效识别在漏报中频繁出现但在误报中很少出现（或反之）的谓词，从而极大缩减规则编辑的指数级搜索空间。此过程持续到收敛，产生平衡精确率和召回率的可解释规则。AutoSpec 在涵盖代码执行和具身智能体领域的 291 条执行轨迹上进行了评估。在两个领域中，规则 F1 分数分别提升至 0.98 和 0.93，误报率降低高达 94%，同时保持高召回率，并在 4-5 次迭代内收敛。ILP 引导的方法在 F1 上比启发式 CEGIS 高出 4.8 倍。学习到的规则具有可读性、可审计性，并能泛化到未见场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 智能体安全是当前热点，AutoSpec 提供了一种自动生成可解释、高精度安全规则的方法，解决了手工规则易误报/漏报的难题，对提升智能体可靠性和可审计性有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于所有使用 LLM 智能体的场景，如代码执行、具身机器人、自动化办公等，可迁移到需要动态安全策略的领域。

items.title: Inside Crypter-as-a-Service: An Ecosystem Analysis of the exploit.in Underground Forum Research Talks
items.summary: Crypter-as-a-Service (CraaS) has become a key enabling layer of the contemporary malware economy by providing on-demand evasion capabilities through underground service markets. In this paper, we present a longitudinal characterization of the CraaS ecosystem on exploit.in, a major Russian-language cybercrime forum with a presence on both the clear web and the dark web. From a collection of approximately 1,000,000 posts, we combine keyword filtering, LLM-assisted annotation, and manual validation to extract a corpus of 491 threads and 2,949 posts spanning January 2020 to August 2025. Our analysis shows that crypters on exploit.in are not merely sold as static tools, but as continuously maintained operational services whose value depends on recurring stub renewal - sometimes on a daily basis - sustained antivirus evasion, and trust-based delivery. We develop a taxonomy of five seller types and four buyer profiles, and map the buyer-seller correspondences that structure market transactions. We further document pricing models ranging from low-cost per-build Telegram bot services to high-end custom development and salaried recruitment. Using social-network analysis, we find that the market is hierarchically structured around a small core of highly central actors, many of whom appear to function as trust brokers or other influential intermediaries, while its stability relies on a broader trust and governance infrastructure including escrow, guarantors, reputation systems, and security deposits. Finally, we discuss differences between the CraaS model observed on exploit.in and that reported on HackForums. Although both forums share similar service logics, our corpus suggests that exploit.in exhibits a more professionalized and service-oriented CraaS configuration.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文通过对俄语网络犯罪论坛 exploit.in（同时存在于明网和暗网）上约100万个帖子进行纵向分析，结合关键词过滤、LLM辅助标注和人工验证，提取了2020年1月至2025年8月间491个线程和2949篇帖子，对加密器即服务（CraaS）生态系统进行了全面刻画。研究发现，exploit.in上的加密器并非作为静态工具出售，而是作为持续维护的运营服务，其价值依赖于频繁的stub更新（有时每日更新）、持续的反病毒逃逸能力以及基于信任的交付机制。作者建立了包含5种卖家类型和4种买家画像的分类法，并映射了买卖双方之间的对应关系，揭示了市场交易结构。定价模型从低成本的按构建付费的Telegram机器人服务到高端定制开发和带薪招聘不等。通过社会网络分析，发现市场围绕一小群高度核心的参与者形成分层结构，其中许多人充当信任中介或其他有影响力的中间人；市场的稳定性依赖于更广泛的信任和治理基础设施，包括托管、担保人、声誉系统和保证金。最后，本文对比了exploit.in与HackForums上CraaS模型的差异，指出exploit.in呈现出更加专业化和服务导向的CraaS配置。该研究为理解现代恶意软件经济中的免杀服务供应链提供了重要视角，适合安全分析师、威胁情报研究人员和网络犯罪生态研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 帮助蓝队理解攻击者如何通过CraaS持续获取免杀能力，洞悉地下恶意软件供应链的运作模式和信任机制，从而更有效地设计防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对了解恶意软件生态、制定针对性的检测与响应措施有参考价值，尤其适用于研究勒索软件、银行木马等依赖免杀技术的攻击。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：将CraaS运营模式纳入威胁情报分析框架，监控类似论坛活动以提前发现新出现的免杀服务。

items.title: Decoherence as Defence and the Magnitude of Noise Regularisation: A Rigorous N -Qubit Theory of Stochastic Quantum Neural Networks for Adversarially Robust Network Intrusion Detection
items.summary: Stochastic quantum neural networks (SQNNs) encode neuronal activations as qubits, synaptic topology as entanglement, and neural noise through a Lindblad master equation. A recent conference study applied a ring-entangled SQNN to collaborative intrusion detection and reached three conclusions: ring entanglement is \emph{essential} for non-local anomaly detection; an adversarial-resilience bound holds but is \emph{conservative}; and the depolarising channel \emph{fails} to act as a dropout-style regulariser, behaving instead as output noise. It left open whether a per-gate stochastic deactivation (``true quantum dropout'') could regularise where the depolarising channel could not, and whether the loose robustness bound could be replaced by a predictive theory. This paper resolves both and extends the framework to real data and to neutral-atom hardware. We give an $N$-qubit formulation through the stochastic master equation and its vectorised Liouvillian, and prove a \emph{decoherence-contraction theorem}: a depolarising channel of strength $γ$ over $L$ entangling layers contracts every weight-$w$ Pauli read-out by a factor $(1-4γ/3)^{wL}$ (for the weight-$1$ read-out used here, $(1-4γ/3)^{L}$); building on the general noise-as-defence result of Du et al., we make this quantitative and operational for intrusion detection. On the real NSL-KDD dataset under white-box FGSM and PGD attacks, a depolarising SQNN trained with the channel is, over seven seeds under strong $\ell_\infty$/$\ell_2$ attacks, significantly more robust than the noiseless circuit ($\ell_\infty$ PGD-$20$, $p=0.04$, large effect) and, critically, never suffers the catastrophic robustness collapse that the noiseless model and gradient-trained classical detectors (which fall from $95\%$ to $47\%$) do, cutting robustness variance roughly twofold; we show this robustness arises from a noise-reshaped training boundary rather than from attack-time gradient contraction. For generalisation, we derive an adaptive-penalty formula showing that per-gate dropout implements a curvature-weighted $L_2$ penalty $\tfrac{p(1-p)}{2}\sumθ^2\partial^2_θL$ in weight space, maximised at $p=1/2$, whereas depolarising noise implements an output-space penalty. A $30$-seed study confirms the formula's quantitative prediction: both mechanisms reduce the train-test gap by a small but statistically significant margin ($\approx\!0.01$; $p<10^{-4}$ and $p=0.004$), are statistically indistinguishable from each other, and the effect is concentrated where overfitting is largest; increasing the dropout rate past $1/2$ does not help, as the formula predicts. The single-seed dichotomy of prior work does not survive replication. We close with a neutral-atom realisation and a feasibility-by-$N$ analysis.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对随机量子神经网络（SQNN）在网络入侵检测中的对抗鲁棒性问题进行了深入理论和实验研究。背景方面，现有研究指出环状纠缠SQNN在协作入侵检测中表现优异，但去极化通道无法像经典dropout那样正则化，且鲁棒性界限保守。本文解决了这两个开放问题，并扩展至真实数据与中性原子硬件。理论层面，作者给出N量子比特的随机主方程及其矢量化Liouvillian形式，证明去极化收缩定理：强度为γ的去极化通道经L层纠缠后，每个权重w的Pauli读出收缩因子为(1-4γ/3)^{wL}，从而将噪声作为防御的手段量化。在NSL-KDD数据集上，针对白盒FGSM和PGD攻击，去极化SQNN相比无噪声电路显著更鲁棒（ℓ∞ PGD-20攻击下p=0.04，效应量较大），且关键是不会像无噪声模型和梯度训练的经典检测器那样发生灾难性鲁棒性崩溃（经典检测器从95%降至47%），鲁棒性方差降低约两倍。作者证明鲁棒性来源于噪声重塑的训练边界而非攻击时的梯度收缩。泛化方面，导出自适应惩罚公式：逐门dropout在权重空间实现曲率加权的L2惩罚，在p=1/2时最大；而去极化噪声实现输出空间惩罚。30次种子实验确认公式的定量预测：两种机制均以统计显著但较小的幅度（约0.01，p<10^{-4}和p=0.004）缩小训练-测试差距，且两者无统计差异；当dropout率超过1/2时无额外收益，与公式一致。先前工作的单种子二分法未被复现。最后给出中性原子实现和可行性分析。本文适合对量子机器学习、对抗鲁棒性、网络入侵检测及正则化理论感兴趣的读者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次从理论上严格证明量子噪声可作为对抗防御机制，并在真实网络流量数据集上验证了去极化SQNN相比经典模型和量子无噪声模型的显著鲁棒性优势，为后量子时代安全防御提供新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升量子机器学习在网络入侵检测中的实际可行性，其噪声正则化理论可迁移至其他量子分类任务；对经典对抗训练方法提供量子视角的补充。

items.title: Kops: Safely Extending the eBPF Compilation Pipeline with Native Operations
items.summary: eBPF safely extends OS kernels in domains such as networking, observability, and security. The safety comes from an in-kernel compilation pipeline where a verifier checks every program, and a kernel just-in-time compiler (JIT) translates the verified bytecode to native code. The kernel keeps the JIT simple to stay trustworthy, translating one bytecode instruction at a time in a single pass. This single-pass design misses optimization opportunities, so eBPF runs up to twice as slow as natively compiled code in our characterization. Adding optimizations to the kernel JIT directly requires upstream acceptance and a long release cycle, enlarges the trusted computing base (TCB), and grows the per-architecture kernel code. To address this, we present Kops, an extension interface that lets userspace compilers and kernel modules introduce new operations without modifying the kernel core, while keeping a minimal trusted computing base (TCB). Each operation has two forms, a proof sequence of vanilla eBPF instructions that the existing verifier checks and a native emit of machine instructions that the JIT compiles. Because the verifier checks the proof sequence, the native emit is the only per-operation addition to the TCB. Hardware idioms are the lowest-hanging fruit for this interface. With Kops, we build EInsn, seven operations such as rotate and conditional select that CPUs execute as single instructions. Lean 4 proofs show that each native emit computes the same result as its proof sequence. On x86-64 and ARM64, EInsn speeds up eBPF microbenchmarks by up to 24% and production applications by up to 12%. The same interface also supports whole-program native replacement, reaching 2.358x at the cost of a larger TCB.

llm_summary.summary_zh: eBPF 技术通过内核中的编译管道（包括验证器和即时编译器 JIT）安全地扩展操作系统，广泛应用于网络、可观测性和安全等领域。然而，当前内核 JIT 采用单遍翻译方式，即每次只翻译一条字节码指令，这虽然保持了简单性以增强可信性，但错失了优化机会。研究表明，eBPF 程序的运行速度比原生编译代码慢最多 2 倍。直接在内核 JIT 中添加优化需要上游接受、经历漫长的发布周期，会扩大可信计算基（TCB），并增加每架构的内核代码量。为解决此问题，本文提出 Kops——一种扩展接口，允许用户态编译器或内核模块引入新的操作，而无需修改内核核心，同时保持极小的 TCB。每个操作包含两种形式：一是由现有验证器检查的普通 eBPF 指令构成的证明序列，二是由 JIT 编译的原生机器指令发射。由于验证器检查证明序列，原生发射是每个操作对 TCB 的唯一新增部分。硬件原生指令（如旋转、条件选择）是该接口最容易获益的目标。基于 Kops，作者构建了 EInsn，实现了 7 种 CPU 单指令操作（如 rotate、conditional select）。通过 Lean 4 形式化证明，每个原生发射与证明序列计算结果一致。在 x86-64 和 ARM64 上，EInsn 使 eBPF 微基准测试性能提升最高 24%，生产应用性能提升最高 12%。该接口还支持全程序原生替换，性能提升可达 2.358 倍，但 TCB 会相应增大。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: eBPF 性能优化是云原生和系统安全领域的关键痛点。Kops 在不破坏安全假设的前提下，提供了一种可扩展的、验证正确的优化路径，对内核开发者和高阶 eBPF 用户极具参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于所有依赖 eBPF 的网络安全工具（如 Cilium、Falco）的性能加速，尤其适合需要高频数据包处理或观测的场景。

items.title: A Conditional Timing Protection Level: Holdover-Limited Undetected Time Error Under GNSS Spoofing
items.summary: A GNSS timing receiver under spoofing has no nominal-geometry fault for position-domain RAIM to bound: the threat is a slow, common-mode pull of served clock time that the receiver's own time-accuracy flag need not reveal. We make three graded contributions. First, a field measurement: solving the receiver clock trajectory from raw L1 pseudoranges and broadcast ephemeris, we show a recorded over-the-air spoof from the public JammerTest 2024 campaign pulled a u-blox ZED-F9P by about 1.01 ms of served time while it reported at most 51 ns, a gap near 20,000x. Second, an impossibility: against an adversary free to choose the ramp rate, no finite unconditional bound on undetected time error exists under a single self-referential clock-aided monitor, because a ramp slow enough to keep the disciplined reference in lock-step is never alarmed while the error grows without limit, so any finite guarantee is conditional. Third, the conditional bound: the Timing Protection Level (TPL), a model-free monitor's static detectability floor plus the oscillator's coast over the detection latency, holds given detection by an independent cross-satellite consistency check a coherent spoofer does not drive in lock-step. Each term is a closed form over a primitive verified in the open Kshana simulator, so the sum is reproducible by hand. Calibrated on the recorded attack, the budget is 114 ns at one-second recovery and 458 ns at a 60-second coast, thousands of times below the 1.01 ms accepted; a clock-aided sequential test alone gives essentially no protection on this slow ramp (it alarms only near the ~1 ms capture), while the model-free monitor alarms during the ramp. We are explicit: the bound is calibrated, not field-validated; carries no integrity-risk budget; and is reported as a band at long coast. The simulator, bound, and calibration example are open source under AGPL-3.0.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对GNSS授时接收机在欺骗攻击下的时间误差防护问题进行了深入研究。首先，通过实地测量，作者在公开的JammerTest 2024活动中记录了一次空中欺骗攻击，该攻击使u-blox ZED-F9P接收机的服务时间偏移了约1.01毫秒，而接收机自身报告的时间误差仅为51纳秒，两者相差近20000倍，揭示了现有接收机时间精度标志的严重不足。其次，从理论上证明：在单一自参考时钟辅助监控器下，面对可自由选择斜坡速率的对手，有限的无条件时间误差上界不存在，因为只要斜坡足够慢，受控参考时钟会保持同步，误差却无限增长，因此任何有限保证都是有条件的。最后，提出了一种条件性防护水平——时序防护水平（Timing Protection Level, TPL），它由模型无关监控器的静态可检测性下限加上检测延迟期间振荡器的漂移组成，前提是检测依赖于独立跨卫星一致性检查，而相干欺骗者无法驱动该检查同步。每个项都是闭式表达式，可在开源Kshana模拟器中验证。基于实际攻击校准，在1秒恢复时间下预算为114纳秒，60秒维持时间下为458纳秒，远低于接受的1.01毫秒；而时钟辅助序贯测试在慢斜坡下几乎无保护（仅在接近~1毫秒捕获时报警），模型无关监控器则在斜坡期间报警。作者明确指出该预算为校准值，未经现场验证，不承担完整性风险预算，且在长时间维持下以带状形式报告。论文提供了开源模拟器、防护水平和校准示例（AGPL-3.0协议）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: GNSS授时欺骗可导致关键基础设施（电力、金融、通信）时间同步失效，而现有接收机自检能力存在巨大盲区。本文揭示了这一漏洞并首次提出可计算的条件性防护水平，对设计抗欺骗授时系统具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖GNSS授时的系统，包括电力网同步、金融交易时间戳、5G基站同步等。防护水平可直接用于评估欺骗风险并设计监控策略。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议授时系统运营方评估内部GNSS接收机对慢速欺骗的防护能力，参考本文TPL方法进行监控升级。

items.title: CORE-BREW: LLR-Based Soft Decoding for Robust Multi-Bit LLM Watermarking
items.summary: Reliable provenance for LLM outputs requires multi-bit watermarks that remain robust under editing while maintaining strict false-positive control. Existing ECC-based LLM watermarks rely largely on hard-decision decoding, discarding token-level reliability information. We propose CORE-BREW, a Constant-hit-Rate Embedding extension of block-wise BREW for robust multi-bit watermarking. CORE-BREW calibrates the watermark channel by targeting a fixed hit rate p-star, yielding closed-form per-token log-likelihood ratios (LLRs) for principled soft-decision decoding. It supports two detection modes: Strict-Safe, which preserves the bounded-distance designated-codeword acceptance region, and FPR-Calibrated, which uses likelihood-based scoring and lightweight list decoding to characterize the FPR-TPR trade-off. Experiments on open-source LLMs under token-level edits and paraphrasing demonstrate improved low-FPR discrimination and robustness over prior multi-bit watermarking baselines while maintaining comparable semantic quality.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）输出溯源需求，提出一种基于对数似然比（LLR）的软判决解码方法 CORE-BREW，用于实现鲁棒的多位水印嵌入与检测。现有基于纠错码（ECC）的 LLM 水印大多采用硬判决解码，丢弃了 token 级别的可靠性信息。CORE-BREW 通过设定固定命中率 p-star 来校准水印信道，从而推导出每个 token 的闭合形式 LLR，实现原理化的软判决解码。它支持两种检测模式：Strict-Safe 模式保持有界距离的指定码字接受区域，适用于严格假阳性控制；FPR-Calibrated 模式采用基于似然的评分和轻量级列表解码，刻画假阳性率与真阳性率之间的权衡。在开源 LLM 上针对 token 级编辑和释义攻击的实验表明，该方法在低假阳性率区间的判别能力和鲁棒性优于现有的多位水印基线，同时保持相近的语义质量。该研究为 LLM 输出来源认证提供了更可靠的机制，适合从事 AI 安全、模型水印及内容溯源的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM 水印是追踪 AI 生成内容来源、防止滥用的关键技术。CORE-BREW 通过软解码显著提升鲁棒性和低假阳性率控制，为部署更可靠的水印方案提供理论基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于 LLM 服务商、内容审核平台及数字版权保护场景，提升 AI 生成内容的可追溯性和防篡改能力。

items.title: DoHFuse: A Dual-Branch Architecture with DMAGLSTM for Website Fingerprinting over DNS over HTTPS/3
items.summary: As personal data privacy becomes increasingly critical in Internet of Things (IoT) environments, secure DNS protocols such as DNS over HTTPS (DoH) and DNS over TLS (DoT) have been widely adopted to protect device communications. However, without effective obfuscation, these protocols remain vulnerable to Website Fingerprinting (WF) attacks that can reveal user activity. With the ongoing deployment of DNS over HTTP/3 (DoH/3) in modern networked systems, padding strategies have been increasingly applied in practice. It is therefore essential to investigate whether DoH/3 can effectively mitigate WF attacks in realistic IoT and edge-network scenarios. To address this, we first collect and publicly release the first real-world benchmark dataset of DoH/3 traffic, generated from domain resolution processes in practical network environments. We further propose DoHFuse, a dual-branch learning framework that integrates inter-arrival time sequences and refined statistical features through an improved DMAG-LSTM, specifically designed to capture burst-aligned temporal patterns. Experimental results show that DoHFuse achieves an accuracy of 88.05% (precision 88.56, recall 87.96, F1 87.83) in a closed-world setting of 449 classes, and an AUPRC of 0.975 with an F1 score of 0.951 (precision 0.906, recall 1.0) in open-world detection. These findings demonstrate that DoH/3 traffic remains susceptible to WF attacks, suggesting that commonly deployed padding mechanisms alone are insufficient to ensure privacy protection in IoT-scale encrypted DNS communications.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对物联网环境中DNS over HTTPS/3 (DoH/3) 流量的网站指纹攻击问题展开研究。随着个人数据隐私日益重要，DoH和DoT等安全DNS协议被广泛采用，但若无有效混淆，这些协议仍易受网站指纹攻击。随着DoH/3在现代网络系统中的部署，填充策略已实际应用，因此有必要研究DoH/3能否在真实物联网和边缘网络场景中有效缓解网站指纹攻击。为此，作者首先收集并公开发布了首个真实世界的DoH/3流量基准数据集，该数据集来源于实际网络环境中的域名解析过程。接着，作者提出了DoHFuse，一种双分支学习框架，该框架通过改进的DMAG-LSTM网络整合了到达时间间隔序列和精细统计特征，专门设计用于捕获与突发对齐的时间模式。实验结果表明，在包含449个类别的封闭世界场景下，DoHFuse达到了88.05%的准确率（精确率88.56，召回率87.96，F1分数87.83）；在开放世界检测中，AUPRC为0.975，F1分数为0.951（精确率0.906，召回率1.0）。这些发现表明DoH/3流量仍然易受网站指纹攻击，暗示常用的填充机制本身不足以在物联网规模的加密DNS通信中确保隐私保护。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究表明，即使采用DoH/3并应用填充策略，网站指纹攻击仍然有效，对使用加密DNS的物联网设备的隐私构成威胁，提醒安全社区需进一步探索更强的防御措施。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用DoH/3进行域名解析的物联网和边缘网络场景，可能暴露用户访问的网站信息。
